# Mimir Nest

Mimir Nest is a free and open-source platform for college students, providing academic, learning, productivity, DSA, placement, project, and career-oriented tools.

## Core Features and Pages

- **Home (/)**: Overview of the platform and features.
- **Courses (/courses)**: Handpicked, high-quality, free courses and academic learning paths tailored for students.
- **Roadmaps (/roadmaps)**: Flexible step-by-step career developer roadmaps.
- **Placement & DSA (/placement-dsa)**: A curated vault of Data Structures and Algorithms questions from 190+ top tech companies.
- **Projects (/projects)**: A curated directory of open-source project ideas and build guides.
- **CGPA Calculator (/cgpa)**: Mathematically rigorous credit-weighted grade calculator and GPA predictor.
- **Pomodoro Timer (/pomodoro)**: Customizable focus timer with ambient soundscapes.
- **Typing Practice (/typing)**: Developer-centric speed and accuracy assessment tool.
- **Student Perks (/email-perks)**: Verified software discounts and perks using academic university email addresses.
- **About (/about)**: Mission, values, and origin of Mimir Nest.
- **FAQ (/faq)**: Frequently asked questions.
- **Privacy (/privacy)**: Privacy policy outlining the local-first data processing.

## Project Resources
- Production Domain: https://mimirnest.vercel.app
- GitHub Organization: https://github.com/Mimir-nest
- Main Repository: https://github.com/Mimir-nest/mimir-nest
